get_envelope_by_label: get an envelope object by passing an EnvelopeLabel to get_envelope for use in FermiNet QMC calculations
create_isotropic_envelope: create an isotropic exponentially decaying multiplicative envelope using make_isotropic_envelope for pre-determinant application
create_bottleneck_envelope: create a bottleneck envelope with a fixed number of envelopes projected linearly into orbital space
create_full_envelope: create a fully anisotropic exponentially decaying envelope using make_full_envelope with covariance-based distance computation
create_sto_envelope: create a Slater-type orbital envelope with polynomial terms using make_sto_envelope for pre-orbital application
